title: Portolan Registry Export
description: exports/catalogs.json: a STAC Catalog whose child links are the registered Portolan catalogs.

links.description: The root and self links, followed by one child link per registered catalog.

bbox.description: WGS84 bounding box, [west, south, east, north] or [west, south, min_alt, east, north, max_alt]. Range and ordering rules beyond arity are checked in the test suite.

portolan_registry:licenses.description: License identifier -> number of collections beneath this catalog declaring it. The identifier is whatever the collection declares: an SPDX id, or a STAC convention such as 'proprietary' or 'other'. Collections declaring no license are the difference against portolan_registry:collection_count.

portolan_registry:spec_version.description: Portolan specification version the catalog claims, parsed from the versioned schema URI in its stac_extensions. Null when it declares none.

portolan_registry:spec_version_mixed.description: True when objects beneath the root declare more than one Portolan version. The spec permits this and asks for a warning, not a rejection.

portolan_registry:updated.description: The catalog's own top-level `updated`, RFC 3339. Null when it sets none.

portolan_registry:first_registered.description: When the entry file was added to this registry, RFC 3339.

portolan_registry:item_count.description: STAC Items beneath this catalog, counted from the rel="item" links its collections publish. The crawler counts those links and never fetches them. Null when no item was countable because every collection holding items lists them behind a rel="items" endpoint, which the crawler does not page. Zero means the catalog was fully enumerable and holds no items. Read portolan_registry:counts_partial before treating a number here as a total.

portolan_registry:total_size_bytes.description: Sum of file:size over the collection-level assets beneath this catalog. Null when nothing declared file:size, which is common: most publishers omit it. Null is the absence of a measurement, where zero would claim the catalog holds no bytes.

portolan_registry:counts_partial.description: True when the counts above are a floor rather than a total, because a child failed to fetch or a collection's items could not be enumerated. Absent on entries carried forward from an export published before this field existed; treat absent as false.
